title: A box that is a name over what belongs to it
description: The same lead-and-detail every label may carry, separated by a rule instead of by weight. A blank-free newline in `text` is the author saying these are two things; `[box] lead` is the theme saying what separates them, and this theme says a line. It is what a class, a record or a component is drawn as by hand — a name, a rule, and the things under it. Who performs a step is the same shape and has its own field: see `actor` and `flow-actors`, which puts the name in the lead so a document does not have to write it into the label.
